name: Env File Write Guard
directive: Never write secrets to .env via Write/Edit/NotebookEdit
message: WARN: editing a .env. Operator directive 2026-07-10 (verbatim: "ja tobie wkleja, api ty dodajesz, nie commitujesz, na tym polega nasza bezpieczna droga") downgraded block->warn — adding operator-pasted keys is the agent's job. STILL BINDING: (1) .env must stay gitignored — NEVER git-add/commit it; (2) NEVER echo secret VALUES to chat or logs; (3) APPEND a new numbered slot, never overwrite an existing key; (4) prefer the Edit tool to append after the provider's last key. (This is the polyglot mirror of ~/.claude/enforcements/env-write-guard.json — kept in sync.)
